# PromptEvalHQ - Empirical Prompt Regression Testing & LLM Evaluation Framework Benchmarks

> Authority reference dataset and benchmarks for LLM Evaluation & Prompt Regression Testing Benchmarks.
> All metrics and guides are 100% free and open-source.

## Core Architectural Guides
- [Promptfoo vs DeepEval: LLM Benchmark & CI/CD Testing Shootout](https://promptevalhq.pages.dev/promptfoo-vs-deepeval-llm-evaluation-benchmark/): Empirical comparison of Promptfoo vs DeepEval for production LLM CI/CD pipelines, regression testing, hallucination scoring, and execution speed.
- [Ragas Evaluation Metrics: Faithfulness & Answer Relevance Tutorial](https://promptevalhq.pages.dev/ragas-metrics-rag-evaluation-python-tutorial/): Step-by-step tutorial on calculating Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, and Context Recall using Ragas with LangChain and LlamaIndex.
- [LLM-as-a-Judge: Best Practices & Cost Optimization Guide](https://promptevalhq.pages.dev/llm-judge-synthetic-dataset-generator-guide/): How to design reliable LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation systems: overcoming position bias, verbosity bias, self-enhancement bias, and minimizing evaluation costs.

## Interactive Tools
- [PromptEvalHQ Sizing Calculator](https://promptevalhq.pages.dev/): Real-time architectural estimator.
